set.body:
Goal: collapse the two representations of the same mapping into one canonical form, deleting the conversion glue.

Evidence: AesSpec[Row] is 8 optional fields (Grammar.scala:51-60); AesEnv[Row] is a map keyed by Aesthetic (AesEnv.scala:9-10); AesSpec.env and AesSpec.fromEnv convert field-by-field (Grammar.scala:107-139); operations round-trip through both (bindScale, inherit at Grammar.scala:119-123); LayerPlan carries both (CompilerPhases.scala:10-11).

Acceptance: pick the map-backed env as canonical (or justify the record), express the public mapping surface on it, and delete fromEnv/env round-trips; no behavior change (same TrainedPlot); JVM+JS tests stay green with fewer lines.
set.title: Graphics: unify AesSpec and AesEnv into one canonical representation
